name: tecnosalud-catolica
description: SPA de Tecnosalud Católica construida con React

scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names frontend,backend,auth,registro,citas,notifications --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta,red,yellow,cyan "npm run dev" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix backend/services/auth-service start" "npm --prefix backend/services/registro-service start" "npm --prefix backend/services/citas-service start" "npm --prefix backend/services/notification-service start"
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix backend/services/auth-service && npm install --prefix backend/services/registro-service && npm install --prefix backend/services/citas-service && npm install --prefix backend/services/notification-service
